title: jmap-client: tests
description: Write the full test suite for jmap-client as specified in PLAN.md. All tests use wiremock — no live network. Tests must verify the Chat-variant removals and security additions made in other beads.
design: Test areas: (1) JmapClient::new() URL validation (empty, bad scheme, path present, query, fragment). (2) fetch_session with mock returning RFC 8620 §2 session JSON. (3) call() round-trip with mock returning JmapResponse. (4) BearerAuth adds correct Authorization header. (5) SSE parse_sse_block with known block formats from jmapchat-client/src/sse.rs inline tests. (6) JmapRequestBuilder unit tests (no network). (7) SPLIT VERIFICATION: assert SseEvent has no Typing or Presence variants (compile-time — use exhaustive match or check variant count). (8) SPLIT VERIFICATION: assert WsFrame has no ChatTyping or ChatPresence variants. (9) SIZE CAP TESTS: mock fetch_session returning > 1 MiB body → expect ClientError::ResponseTooLarge. mock call() returning > 8 MiB body → expect ClientError::ResponseTooLarge. (10) WebSocket @type field: verify outgoing WS frame contains @type: 'Request'.
